title: 邓莫尔遗嘱信托信托会计
instruction:
您是 Ivo Marchenko，Ostrander & Quill 的会计师，为受托人 Cecile Ntumba 处理邓莫尔遗嘱信托文件。该信托公司在三月份出售了其农场地块，塞西尔现在需要提交该信托公司自出售以来的第一份法庭账目；法院和其余受益人的律师将阅读每一份附表和解释性说明。使用适用于遗嘱信托会计的专业惯例，准备一份可供法庭使用的信托会计，塞西尔可以审查、签署和支持，并明确涵盖的期间、信托能力、资产、收入、支出、分配、准备金、损益和期末余额。包裹交易是焦点：销售收入、折旧准备和Cecile的调整权选举相互制约，因此列报必须使会计结​​果可追溯，而不是留下非正式的分配票据。对于属于律师、税务顾问或独立评估职能部门的问题，请保持清晰的界限；请勿将会计结果转化为法律建议或对任何人最终权利的裁决。 Vantridge Utilities 和 Quarryfield Analytics 出现在文件历史记录中，因此仅在会计记录支持的范围内识别其角色，并且不要制造有关这两个组织的事实。
包括对会计基础、来源限制、未解决的问题以及法院审查员需要理解的任何假设的简明解释，并积极提醒读者不要使用会计本身来代替命令、信托解释、税收确定或受益人权利决定。制作一份精美的 Word 文档，准确命名为`dunmore_testamentary_trust_fiduciary_accounting.docx`；将其写入求解器启动的工作目录的顶层。将完成的会计控制不超过八页，使用专业的法庭归档演示文稿，使时间表和总计易于审计，避免捏造交易金额或不受支持的结论，并以会计和证明材料结束，而不是建议的后续步骤列表。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `dunmore_testamentary_trust_fiduciary_accounting.docx` — 邓莫尔遗嘱信托的法庭准备信托会计，包括时间表、解释性说明、限制和证明材料。 （必须写入求解器起始工作目录的顶层；呈现时不得超过八页；不得发明交易金额、日期、当事人、法律结论、税务处理或估值结论；必须将会计列报与法律、税务、估值和受益人权利确定区分开来；必须在所有明细表、叙述性解释和总计之间保持内部一致）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。

DUNMORE TESTAMENTARY TRUST
FIDUCIARY ACCOUNTING • FIRST ACCOUNTING AFTER FARM-PARCEL SALE
Court-facing filing draft | Trustee: Cecile Ntumba | Prepared by: Ivo Marchenko, Ostrander & Quill
Matter
Reported status
Fiduciary capacity
Cecile Ntumba, trustee of the Dunmore Testamentary Trust
Accounting period
Period ending after the March farm-parcel sale; exact start/end dates are not supplied
Preparation date
24 August 2026 (draft from supplied file history only)
Record status
No ledger, bank statements, closing statement, governing instrument, prior accounting, or court order supplied

Purpose and scope
This accounting presents the trust’s beginning position, activity, and ending position for Cecile Ntumba’s review and potential filing. It is an accounting presentation—not a trust construction, legal opinion, tax determination, independent appraisal, or decision about any beneficiary’s ultimate entitlement. The March sale is distinct so consideration, costs, carrying value, depreciation reserve, and proceeds can be traced without inventing figures.
“Unavailable—record required” is not zero. The supplied record prevents a numerical proof of cash and net assets; totals are therefore pending rather than manufactured.
Reader caution
Neither this draft, a schedule within it, nor a future approval of the accounting by itself establishes what an income beneficiary or remainder beneficiary is legally entitled to receive. Do not use it as a substitute for the governing instrument, counsel’s interpretation, a tax adviser’s determination, an independent valuation, or a court order. Any approval would not silently resolve matters identified as unresolved.


1. Basis, evidence, and responsibilities
Accounting basis and conventions
The draft uses a modified-cash fiduciary accounting basis: receipts and disbursements are reported when collected or paid; period-end assets and liabilities are listed separately; and non-cash entries (such as reserve clearance) are disclosed as accounting changes rather than cash. Principal (corpus) and fiduciary accounting income are separated where relevant. A transaction is not income merely because it creates cash. No unrealized valuation change is reported.

Opening basis and party identification
No prior accounting, trust inventory, or opening statements were supplied. Beginning cash, investments, receivables, parcel carrying value, depreciation reserve, and liabilities are controlled placeholders, not asserted balances. Vantridge Utilities and Quarryfield Analytics appear only in file history. The supplied record does not establish whether either was a payer, payee, service provider, broker, appraiser, or otherwise involved. No amount, contract, valuation, or relationship is attributed to either organization.

Depreciation reserve and valuation boundary
The depreciation reserve is an accumulated non-cash contra-asset associated with the parcel. It is not cash and is not available for distribution merely because the parcel was sold. On disposal it is cleared or reclassified against carrying value; the amount and exact presentation remain pending the reserve ledger. Reserve clearance changes book presentation and gain/loss computation—it does not create a second receipt or add cash to net proceeds.
Gain/loss is withheld because consideration, costs, cost basis, and accumulated depreciation are unavailable. Quarryfield Analytics is not treated as an appraiser. No accountant-created amount is fair market value. Tax basis, tax gain/loss, and tax consequences require a tax adviser and records.


5. Principal/income and power-to-adjust analysis
Integrated allocation note
March proceeds are presented first as realized proceeds of a principal asset. The reserve is a non-cash contra-asset cleared or reclassified on disposal, not distributable cash. Supported sale costs reduce net proceeds. Whether proceeds, reserve-related effects, or other receipts are allocated between principal and fiduciary accounting income depends on the governing instrument, applicable law, and a documented trustee decision.

This is a neutral accounting presentation of an unresolved classification question. Counsel must confirm authority; the trustee must document any election, effective period, and allocation. The accountant records documented action and audit trail, not whether an election was legally available or prudent.
Remainder interests
Remainder beneficiaries are referenced only as a class because names, shares, and the governing instrument were not supplied. Their interests are not adjudicated. No schedule establishes a present right to proceeds, reserve release, or another amount.

7. Accounting certification and verification
Preparer’s statement. Ivo Marchenko, accountant at Ostrander & Quill, prepared this filing draft from the limited file history in Section 1. I present schedules and qualifications as an accounting professional. I am not the trustee, do not make trustee fiduciary decisions, and do not certify legal entitlement, tax treatment, valuation, or records not supplied.
Trustee verification. I, Cecile Ntumba, trustee of the Dunmore Testamentary Trust, have reviewed this draft to the extent of records available to me. Subject to stated unavailable-data limitations and corrections before filing, I verify that it is intended to report trust activity for the stated period and that I will not treat an unavailable field as zero. Signing confirms my review and capacity; it does not waive rights, construe the trust, determine tax, establish fair market value, or constitute a court order.
The trustee should sign only after reviewing ledger, statements, sale/closing records, reserve support, distributions, liabilities, and any power-to-adjust documentation. This describes verification, not a recommendation about distribution or fiduciary action.

criteria.description: 所需的 Word 可交付成果位于顶层，正好位于所请求的文件名下。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件路径和文件名。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查提交根目录并验证确切的基本名称和 .docx 扩展名。

original.criterion: The required Word deliverable exists at the top level under exactly the requested filename.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the submission root and verify the exact basename and .docx extension.

criteria.description: 渲染的会计不超过八页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用离线 Office 渲染器渲染 DOCX 并计数页面。

original.criterion: The rendered accounting is no more than eight pages.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX with an offline office renderer and count pages.

criteria.description: 该文件指定邓莫尔遗嘱信托基金和塞西尔·恩通巴为受托人。
criteria.grader_hint: 在标题或介绍材料中查找信托名称和受托人名称。

original.criterion: The document identifies the Dunmore Testamentary Trust and Cecile Ntumba as trustee.
original.grader_hint: Look for the trust name and trustee name in the title or introductory material.

criteria.description: 该文件将 Ivo Marchenko 或 Ostrander & Quill 确定为编制者或编制者公司，但未将编制者列为受托人。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证编制者角色与受托人角色是否有区别。

original.criterion: The document identifies Ivo Marchenko or Ostrander & Quill as preparer or preparer's firm without presenting the preparer as trustee.
original.grader_hint: Verify the preparer role is distinguished from the fiduciary role.

criteria.description: 会计期间以及其遵循三月份农场包裹销售的事实均得到明确说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要明确的报告期和与三月销售的明确联系。

original.criterion: The accounting period and the fact that it follows the March farm-parcel sale are stated clearly.
original.grader_hint: Require both a defined reporting period and an explicit connection to the March sale.

criteria.description: 该凭证将期初资产或负债、期间活动以及期末余额分开。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查这三种状态是否可以在不从散文中重建的情况下找到它们。

original.criterion: The document separates beginning assets or liabilities, activity during the period, and ending balances.
original.grader_hint: Check that the three states can be located without reconstructing them from prose.

criteria.description: 会计将信托本金或主体与信托会计收入区分开来（如果存在相关区别）。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受明确解释的等效术语，但需要操作上的区别，而不仅仅是标签。

original.criterion: The accounting distinguishes trust principal or corpus from fiduciary accounting income where the distinction is relevant.
original.grader_hint: Accept a clearly explained equivalent terminology, but require an operational distinction rather than labels alone.

criteria.description: 每一份报告的收据都可以追溯到日期或期间、来源或付款人、金额或明确不可用的金额以及分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 收据样本并验证最小可追溯字段；不受支持的金额可能会被标记为不可用，而不是发明。

original.criterion: Every reported receipt is traceable to a date or period, source or payer, amount or explicit unavailable amount, and classification.
original.grader_hint: Sample receipts and verify the minimum traceability fields; unsupported amounts may be marked unavailable rather than invented.

criteria.description: 每笔报告的支出都可以追溯到日期或期间、收款人、目的、金额或明确不可用的金额以及分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 对支出进行抽样并核实目的和本金/收入处理方式均未遗漏。

original.criterion: Every reported disbursement is traceable to a date or period, payee, purpose, amount or explicit unavailable amount, and classification.
original.grader_hint: Sample disbursements and verify that purpose and principal/income treatment are not omitted.

criteria.description: 该文件在适用时确定了现金、投资、财产、应收账款、准备金和负债类别，并适当地标记了不支持活动的类别。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找完整的资产/负债清单，并在适当的情况下明确零、无或未报告的处理方法。

original.criterion: The document identifies cash, investment, property, receivable, reserve, and liability categories when applicable and labels categories with no supported activity appropriately.
original.grader_hint: Look for a complete asset/liability inventory and explicit zero, none, or not reported treatment where appropriate.

criteria.description: 期初余额与之前的会计、信托库存或规定的期初基础相关，而不是显示为无法解释的数字。
criteria.evidence: 期初余额附注和明细表。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果能够解释限制并避免错误的精确性，则对不可用的先前记录的声明是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The opening balance is connected to the prior accounting, trust inventory, or stated opening basis rather than appearing as an unexplained number.
original.grader_hint: A statement of unavailable prior records is acceptable if it explains the limitation and avoids false precision.

criteria.description: 期末余额调节期初余额加上收入和收益减去支出、分配、损失和其他规定的变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用文档自己的数字重新执行所提供的调节；如果无法获得数字，请核实是否明确披露了该数字，而不是默默地进行了平衡。

original.criterion: The ending balance reconciles beginning balance plus receipts and gains minus disbursements, distributions, losses, and other stated changes.
original.grader_hint: Reperform the presented reconciliation using the document's own figures; if figures are unavailable, verify that the absence is explicitly disclosed rather than silently balanced.

criteria.description: 会计分别确定受托人分配、受益人分配以及出于信托目的进行的转移或付款。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查分配款项是否被隐藏在一般支出中。

original.criterion: The accounting separately identifies trustee distributions, beneficiary distributions, and transfers or payments made for trust purposes.
original.grader_hint: Check that distributions are not buried in general disbursements.

criteria.description: 该文件将受托人报酬和报销费用与第三方信托费用分开，或明确报告不支持任何费用。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要区别对待，而不仅仅是通用的行政费用项目。

original.criterion: The document identifies trustee compensation and reimbursed expenses separately from third-party trust expenses, or expressly reports that none is supported.
original.grader_hint: Require a distinct treatment, not merely a generic administrative-expense line.

criteria.description: 农场地块在出售前被认定为信托资产，处置则作为一项单独的交易提出。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认包裹首先不会仅以现金形式出现。

original.criterion: The farm parcel is identified as a trust asset before sale and the disposition is presented as a distinct transaction.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the parcel does not first appear only as cash proceeds.

criteria.description: 销售演示区分了总对价、交易成本、净收益以及由此产生的现金或应收账款头寸（当这些事实可用时）。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要从总销售额到净额的桥梁，或者对缺失的组件进行明确的不可用数据披露。

original.criterion: The sale presentation distinguishes gross consideration, transaction costs, net proceeds, and the resulting cash or receivable position when those facts are available.
original.grader_hint: Require a bridge from gross sale amount to net amount, or a clear unavailable-data disclosure for missing components.

criteria.description: 出售日期或报告期安置、买方或交易对手身份（如果支持）以及处置状态均与估值信息区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 请勿以裸销售金额授予此奖励；寻找交易身份和状态。

original.criterion: The sale date or reporting-period placement, buyer or counterparty identity if supported, and disposition status are distinguished from valuation information.
original.grader_hint: Do not award this for a bare sale amount; look for transaction identity and status.

criteria.description: 由于无法获得所需的账面价值证据，因此计算或明确扣留包裹的任何收益或损失。
criteria.grader_hint: 当成本基础、累计折旧或收益不受支持时，有道理的无计算披露即可赢得信用。

original.criterion: Any gain or loss on the parcel is calculated or explicitly withheld because the required carrying-value evidence is unavailable.
original.grader_hint: A defensible no-calculation disclosure earns credit when cost basis, accumulated depreciation, or proceeds are not supported.

criteria.description: 与地块相关的折旧准备或累计折旧单独确定，并解释其处置处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求储备金的身份和销售的会计结果；不接受不明原因的净额结算。

original.criterion: The depreciation reserve or accumulated depreciation associated with the parcel is separately identified and its treatment on disposal is explained.
original.grader_hint: Require both the reserve's identity and the accounting consequence of sale; do not accept an unexplained netting.

criteria.description: 该文件并未将折旧准备金视为可供分配的现金，而未解释其会计性质和处置。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否区分准备金释放、重分类和现金流动。

original.criterion: The document does not treat the depreciation reserve as cash available for distribution without explaining its accounting nature and disposition.
original.grader_hint: Inspect whether reserve release, reclassification, and cash movement are distinguished.

criteria.description: 在支持的范围内，确定了受托人的调整选择权，包括是否行使、有效期限及其影响的会计类别。
criteria.grader_hint: 文件可以将未知的选举状态报告为未知，但不得默默假设行使或不行使。

original.criterion: The trustee's power-to-adjust election is identified, including whether it was exercised, its effective period, and the accounting categories it affects, to the extent supported.
original.grader_hint: A document may report an unknown election status as unknown, but must not silently assume exercise or non-exercise.

criteria.description: 会计解释了调整权处理如何与销售收益、折旧准备金和收入/本金列报相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个相互关联的解释，而不是三个孤立的段落。

original.criterion: The accounting explains how the power-to-adjust treatment relates to the sale proceeds, depreciation reserve, and income/principal presentation.
original.grader_hint: Look for a connected explanation rather than three isolated paragraphs.

criteria.description: 这种分配处理是站得住脚的、内部连贯的，并且在提出时并不假装不受支持的信托法解释已经得到解决。

criteria.description: 该文件确定了来源限制，并将提供的证据与假设、估计或未解决的项目区分开来。

criteria.description: 没有任何不受支持的交易金额、日期、估值、交易对手事实、税务结果或法律结论被作为既定事实提出。

spec.professional_context: This is a court-facing fiduciary accounting for a testamentary trust, prepared by an accounting professional for filing and review by a court and remainder-beneficiary counsel. The document must be complete and usable while remaining within the supplied facts and the accountant's evidentiary role.
difficulty_sources: prescribed fiduciary-accounting structure must be reconstructed from professional knowledge without supplied court forms
sale proceeds, depreciation reserve, income/principal classification, and the trustee's power-to-adjust election must remain internally consistent
the accounting must distinguish presentation of fiduciary facts from legal, tax, valuation, or beneficiary-entitlement advice
the document must actively prevent readers from treating an accounting as a determination of entitlement

authoring_plan.purpose: Construct a credible court-facing fiduciary-accounting draft that teaches through its organization and notes while remaining an accounting assessment rather than legal or tax advice.

gold_construction.document: Create one polished DOCX using only offline tools. Use a caption/title, defined accounting period, preparer and trustee capacities, a short basis-and-limitations statement, summary financial position, receipts, disbursements, distributions, asset and liability schedules, a dedicated farm-parcel disposition schedule, depreciation-reserve treatment, integrated principal/income and power-to-adjust analysis, reconciliation, explanatory notes, and trustee certification.
gold_construction.evidence_policy: Because there are no supplied inputs, do not fabricate amounts, dates, court names, docket numbers, trust provisions, buyer identities, valuations, or tax results. Where a complete filing would ordinarily require a record, show a clearly marked unavailable or confirmation-needed field and explain its impact. Mention Vantridge Utilities and Quarryfield Analytics only as file-history parties with explicitly qualified roles, not as invented transaction participants or valuation authorities.
professional_logic: The parcel must be shown as an asset before disposition and as proceeds or a receivable after disposition.
Gross proceeds, costs of sale, net proceeds, carrying value, accumulated depreciation or reserve, and gain/loss treatment must be distinguishable.
Reserve release or reclassification must not be confused with cash receipt.
Power-to-adjust status must be reported as exercised, not exercised, or unknown based on evidence, with the affected categories and period identified.
Income/principal allocations and any beneficiary distributions must agree with the stated accounting basis and adjustment treatment.
Beginning position, activity, and ending position must reconcile, or the document must transparently explain why a numerical reconciliation cannot yet be completed.
boundary_logic: State that the accounting reports fiduciary activity and presentation judgments but does not construe the trust, determine entitlement, provide tax advice, appraise property, or replace a court order.
Actively warn that neither a schedule nor an approved accounting alone establishes a beneficiary's ultimate legal entitlement.
Use neutral language and avoid recommendations, litigation positions, or assertions that court approval has already occurred.
quality_review: Render the DOCX and verify no more than eight pages.
Recalculate all visible subtotals and reconciliations.
Check that every sale-related concept appears consistently in summary, detail, and notes.
Check that missing evidence is labeled rather than silently filled.
Check readability of tables and that the final substantive material is certification or accounting verification.

authoring_plan.rubric_derivation: Derive the rubric from the professional behaviors above, emphasizing relational consistency and reviewer usability rather than fixed answer values. All 58 items are credit-only as requested; no penalty item duplicates an absence check.

original_instruction:
You are Ivo Marchenko, the accountant at Ostrander & Quill handling the Dunmore Testamentary Trust file for trustee Cecile Ntumba. The trust sold its farm parcel in March, and Cecile now needs to file the trust's first court accounting since that sale; the court and counsel for the remainder beneficiaries will read every schedule and explanatory note. Prepare a court-ready fiduciary accounting that Cecile can review, sign, and stand behind, using the professional conventions applicable to a testamentary-trust accounting and making the period covered, fiduciary capacity, assets, receipts, disbursements, distributions, reserves, gains or losses, and ending balances clear. The parcel transaction is the focal point: the sale proceeds, the depreciation reserve, and Cecile's power-to-adjust election constrain one another, so the presentation must make the accounting consequences traceable rather than leaving an informal allocation note. Keep the boundary clear where questions belong to counsel, a tax adviser, or an independent valuation function; do not turn the accounting into legal advice or a ruling on anyone's ultimate entitlement. Vantridge Utilities and Quarryfield Analytics appear in the file history, so identify their roles only to the extent supported by the accounting record and do not manufacture facts about either organization. Include a concise explanation of the accounting basis, source limitations, unresolved matters, and any assumptions that a court reviewer would need to understand, and actively caution readers against using the accounting itself as a substitute for an order, trust interpretation, tax determination, or beneficiary-entitlement decision. Produce one polished Word document named exactly `dunmore_testamentary_trust_fiduciary_accounting.docx`; write it into the top level of the working directory the solver starts in. Keep the finished accounting to no more than eight pages, use a professional court-filing presentation, make schedules and totals easy to audit, avoid invented transaction amounts or unsupported conclusions, and end with the accounting and certification material rather than a list of proposed next steps.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `dunmore_testamentary_trust_fiduciary_accounting.docx` — A court-ready fiduciary accounting for the Dunmore Testamentary Trust, including schedules, explanatory notes, limitations, and certification material. (must be written into the top level of the solver's starting working directory; must not exceed eight pages when rendered; must not invent transaction amounts, dates, parties, legal conclusions, tax treatment, or valuation conclusions; must distinguish accounting presentation from legal, tax, valuation, and beneficiary-entitlement determinations; must be internally consistent across all schedules, narrative explanations, and totals)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
